profile.headline: Software and Data Engineer in Big Data
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer, with experience in analysis and maintenance of large scale health data systems, with an expertise in DICOM.  Lead developer of products using machine learning for automatic diagnoses.  Exceptional experience in design and implementation of data production and access systems at the petabyte scale, working with distributed systems in international data centers. Proven experience in increasing efficiency of systems in operation, while meeting user's needs.  Experience in data science, inventing new uses for standard tools in the area of general text classification. In the past, program manager for big data production and operations at Stanford Linear Accelerator Center (SLAC), and CERN. Experience includes: 

* Data science in natural language processing.
* Big data management in grid and cloud environments.
* Production systems design and tuning.
* Job management in large international data centers.
* Database server management.
* Software programing in Python, Perl, Java, and C++.
* Increasing efficiency while supporting user's needs.

positions.title: Senoir Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Coordinated Health Image data for AI training and testing, using cloud resources in AWS.
* Created a PACS compliant DICOM query and retrieve service in pydicom.
* Managed health survey to determine reduced anxiety of patients using Whiterabbit systems, which taken by 1000's of patients, using Survey Monkey and Twilio.
* Designed and implemented in house SurveyDB system, to store, access, analyze company health survey data in a Snowflake data warehouse.
* Developed anonymization systems for DICOM data, to remove and encrypt all personal health information (PHI).
* Designed and implemented data processing system for DICOM anonymization using Fargate on AWS.
* Created and maintained Docker images for DICOM anonymization and health survey maintenance, to be run on Fargate and Docker Swarm, managed by Portainer.
* Used Google Health Cloud to store and manage DICOM health data, and anonymization of data, creating a DICOM migration app to move data from AWS.
* Created data access systems for various radiologist information systems (RIS) like eRad, Penrad and MagView.
* Worked with PowerScribe and Mirth connect systems to help improve radiologist experience and efficiency in reading health image data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead Developer on application for Watson Health for AI image analysis of DICOM mamogram data, for an automatic cancer severity advisor.
* Developer of Watson Health Analytic platform for HIPAA compliant data storage and analysis of health advisors.
* Implemented and installed production versions of Watson Health Analytic platform for automatic advisor for diagnosis of aortic stenosis from large sets of HL7 and DICOM data.
* Created Docker images for analytics, storage, messaging, database and web services.
* Managed machine clusters for running Docker containers using Kubernetes.
* Development of natural language processing techniques for extraction of data from web crawl data.
* Filed many patents in the area of natural language processing (NLP).
* Created 11 patents in the IBM patent system that were judged acceptable for filing.
* Developed new processing interface for large scale text analysis using SystemT in Java using Eclipse.
* Developed REST interface using JavaEE and the JAX-RS standard for entity extraction from text using SystemT.
* Developed command line util for large scale text processing and entity extractions in Java using SystemT.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed new method to classify natural intelligent language to subject, using LDA analysis of Blekko slash tag data.
* Filed patent on classification method.
* Presented classification method at the IEEE-ICSC 2015.
* Published paper on classification method "Classification of text to subject using LDA".
* Developed large scale data access on Blekko No-SQL data storage and access system, that scaled to petabyte scale.
* Created a job management framework for use on AWS EC2 resources for the LDA analysis of data.
* Managed access log file archiving for Blekko services on AWS S3.

positions.title: Software Developer, Research Scientist
positions.description:
* Managed and developed tools for a user base of 1000 physicists, for distributed data analysis systems for big data at the size of 3 petabytes.
* Designed and implemented a MapReduce system for internationally distributed data production in the petabyte scale, managing jobs on up to 10,000 machines.
* Coordinated over a dozen data centers around the world for the use of the data production and data storage for analysis.
* Interfaced with a community of hundreds of physicists for data analysis, results of which proved existing theories, and a Nobel Prize in physics was given to these theorists in 2008.
* Administered MySQL and Oracle servers, and developed and maintained access libraries and systems.
* Administered Apache web servers to provide discussions and information the community.
* Developer and manager of discussion group system Hypernews, managing web and e-mail discussions for archiving and searching, with over 500,000 discussion threads.
* Developed web search system on discussions, database logs, web pages, and other experimental information, using Swish-e, indexing nearly 1 million documents.
* Part of development team for Qserv, a distributed database system that scales to 1000's of machines, to store and serve data on the scale of tens of petabytes.
* Developed install procedures for use with Puppet in data centers, scaling to use of many hundreds of machines.
* Designed and implemented use of Zookeeper for storage of server state.
* Setup and use of MySQL servers on up to 1000 machines for production.
* Tested use of Qserv at several international data centers for production, using up to 100 terabytes of data.
* Code management with git.

positions.title: ATLAS distributed computing group
positions.description:
* Lived and worked at CERN, in Geneva, Switzerland from 2009-2011.
* Managed compute jobs on grid environment and data storage in over 50 data centers around the world, for a user base of 1000's of physicists.
* In charge of day to day operations, as part of head data management team, for production, QA, and data availability.
* Maintained data analysis systems for a community of thousands of physicists, which proved theories about the Higgs Boson, and resulted in a Nobel Prize in physics for Higgs in 2013.
* Designed and implemented as part of group for management systems on 100,000's of machines.
* Developed multiprocess job support in production systems.

positions.title: Research PostDoc
positions.description:
* Taught physics for non-majors, ran labs, and ran a weekly research study night.
* Research and development of a new source of ultra-cold neutrons (UCN) at the LANSCE lab in Los Alamos, NM.
* Presented results in national and international conferences.
